registered_before: any run with the event-generator step
reason: the release binary of event-generator v0.13.0 is a PIE that needs the glibc loader (/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2); aims-frontend, aims-redis and aims-redis-sentinel run musl images, so the step would not start there
change: the binary is built from the v0.13.0 source tarball (GitHub archive of the tag) with Go 1.26.3, CGO_ENABLED=0, no PIE, -trimpath -ldflags "-s -w", after make events/k8saudit/yaml/bundle.go: statically linked; checked in alpine:3.20 and busybox:1.36 as uid 1000 (actions executed or permission denied as on glibc)
